name: state_start
description: Start a slide after `state`'s slide, as Add Slide starts one (PLAN 3.30), in one of the theme's layouts: a new state, absolute, in the layout, with a text in each slot that says what goes there, in the slot's role, its words to type over (`replace_text` or `set_text` put yours), the headline the slide's claim and shrunk to fit, a shape in each slot that holds one, and the slots that wait for a picture or a figure left empty; it stays on its slide. One patch, all or none, refused as `deck_patch` refuses one, reported as `deck_patch` reports one with its JSON Patch, with `id`, the new state's (yours, given as `id`), `filled`, each slot and the node in it, and `empty`, each slot left for a picture or a figure and what goes there. `deck_inspect` with `layouts` lists the layouts a state may take.

bundle.description: The bundle: a directory, a `.scaena` zip, or a `deck.json`.

state.description: The state the slide goes after: after the last step of its slide, in its beat.

layout.description:
One of the theme's layouts (`deck_inspect` with `layouts` lists what a state may take,
each by its name; `deck_read` with `theme` gives them all, in its `layouts`). Without it, a blank slide.

claim.description:
The one sentence the slide tells: it starts a beat of its own for it, just after the beat
of the state it follows. Without it, the slide joins that beat.

id.description:
The new state's id, and its nodes' after it (`pricing-header`). Without it, the layout's
name (`bullets`, `bullets-2`, …).

dry_run.description: Say what would change, and write nothing.

SlotFilled.description: A slot of a new slide's layout, and the node put in it (dogfood 3).

SlotEmpty.description:
A slot of a new slide's layout left empty, and what its prompt says goes there: a picture
or a figure, for `add_node` with `at: { in: slot }` to put (dogfood 3).

oneOf.description:
Put `value` at `path`: a member of an object (one already there is replaced, in its
place), or an item of an array, at an index or at its end (`-`).
Replace what is at `path`, which must be there.

`remove` at `from`, then `add` at `path`. A member moved within its object keeps its
place: a rename.
Fail the patch unless `path` holds `value` (numbers equal by value: 1 is 1.0).

Pointer.description:
A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901): empty, the whole document, or `/`-separated tokens, `~1` for a
`/` and `~0` for a `~` inside one.

Finding.description: One lint finding, shaped for agents: a code, a JSON pointer, and (when safe) a fix.

file.description: The bundle file `path` points into, when it is not `deck.json` (a theme file).

format.description: The format the deck was laid out in (`"9:16"`), when it is not the deck's own.

fix.description: A JSON Patch (RFC 6902) that resolves the finding. Only safe, non-content fixes.

refresh.description:
The data source to fetch again, where what resolves the finding is a fetch, which no patch
makes (W428, ADR-0030): the source's name, without its `@`.

id.description:
The id of the state added: named after its layout (`bullets`, `bullets-2`, …), or
`slide` with none.

filled.description: Each slot a node fills, and the node, to put words in with `replace_text` or `set_text`.

empty.description: Each slot left empty for a picture or a figure, and what goes there.

applied.description: Whether the deck was written: not under a dry run, nor when the patch was refused.

patch.description: The patch as RFC 6902, in order.

added.description: What `validate` and `lint` find after the patch that they did not before.

removed.description: What they found before that they do not after.

errors.description: The findings that are errors, after.

states.description:
The states it changes, by id: each whose nodes, resolved with the deck's overrides,
or whose layout, transition, choreography, hold, notes, or slide number and footer are
not as they were, and each it adds. None when it is refused.
